entries.mitigation: Use the synergy immediately to free a cocooned player before role pressure collapses the group.

entries.entry_name: Skeleton Waves — Brothers Ilambris and Ilambris Amalgam

entries.entry_name: Stomp — Brothers Ilambris and Ilambris Amalgam

entries.entry_name: Rain of Fire — Brothers Ilambris and Ilambris Amalgam
entries.mitigation: Keep moving between fire impacts during the low-health enrage while maintaining boss control.
Keep four Students alive until Nerien'eth takes the Ebony Blade, then kill them after the hard-mode condition is satisfied.
Identify the targeted player and dodge roll the skull projectile rather than stacking into another player.
The targeted player uses the resist synergy while the group burns Nerien'eth's damage shield to release them.
